projects.name: Junsu — AI Compliance Platform
bullets: AI compliance platform that maps business activities to risks with structured LLM reasoning and calculated scoring. Live with its first enterprise customer, covering ISO 27001, UNE 19601, ESG and B Corp.
Built the pgvector retrieval layer over customer compliance evidence, with page and character-offset provenance so every AI recommendation cites a source span an auditor can verify.

Designed the LLM assessment pipeline mapping controls to risks: one batched call per activity keeps related judgments consistent, the rubric is cached as a prompt prefix to cut cost, and output is excluded from scoring until a human confirms it.
Shipped on AWS (Bedrock, S3, Cognito, Lambda) with per-tenant Postgres row-level security and a token-level cost ledger reconciled against the AWS bill.

projects.name: TuDiaDeBlanco — All-in-one AI Wedding Platform
bullets: Built the full platform on Next.js, Supabase and Stripe: guest management, seating plans, budgets, invitations, RSVP and public wedding pages, for couples and for planners running multi-wedding portfolios.
Shipped a RAG chatbot over the couple's uploaded documents, with visibility scoping in the retrieval layer separating the guest-facing concierge from the couple's private assistant.

Extended it into an agent that tool-calls live platform data (guests, seating, budget), with a bounded tool-round loop and a similarity-threshold FAQ path that answers common questions without invoking the model.
Multi-tenant by design: role-based memberships (owner / editor / viewer) with module-level permissions, Supabase Postgres row-level security, and Stripe tiers for the self-serve couple channel.
